findings.evidence: template/scripts/execute_requirement.py:638–642 routes portable multi-child delivery through requirement_integration.publish_candidate. For a complete candidate, template/scripts/requirement_integration.py:833 calls _run_full_checks, which unconditionally imports lifecycle_workers at line 750. With that module unavailable, downstream delivery fails before checks or publication. This contradicts the active lifecycle-workers requirement that portable Requirement behavior must not require coordinator modules.
findings.summary: Downstream multi-child Requirement publication still requires the coordinator stack.

findings.evidence: template/scripts/openspec_lifecycle.py:562–567 handles finalize before the only lifecycle_mode call at line 572. Consequently, --finalize does not reject a missing platform_version or an unsupported source combination. With DEV_PLATFORM_COMPOSITION_FINALIZATION set, line 564 imports requirement_composition, whose module-level import at template/scripts/requirement_composition.py:15 loads lifecycle_workers without selecting coordinator mode. This contradicts both active requirements: archive must select through the shared selector, and coordinator modules may load only after coordinator mode is selected.
findings.summary: Archive finalization bypasses lifecycle selection, allowing unsupported contracts to enter source-only behavior.
